# TAMS Pro

> **What is TAMS Pro?** TAMS Pro (`https://tamspro.online`) is cloud travel agency management software built for Pakistani airline ticketing, Umrah, and visa agencies. It unifies bookings, an integrated SAR-to-PKR Umrah Cost Calculator, travel queries and quotations, branded PDF invoices and payment vouchers, automated double-entry PKR client and vendor ledgers, Cash and Bank accounts, and financial reports. Plans start with a 14-day free trial, followed by PKR 1,999/month or PKR 9,999/year (was PKR 19,999 — 50% OFF on the yearly plan).

## Brand & Entity Facts

- **Official Name:** TAMS Pro (Travel Agency Management System)
- **Category:** Cloud Travel Agency Management Software / Umrah & Ticketing ERP (`BusinessApplication`)
- **Primary Audience:** Travel agencies, Umrah operators, airline ticketing agents, sub-agents, and visa consultants in Pakistan
- **Country & Currency:** Pakistan (`en-PK`, `PKR`, with `SAR`-to-`PKR` conversion in the Umrah Cost Calculator)
- **Official Website:** https://tamspro.online
- **Pricing:** 14-day free trial; Monthly Plan: PKR 1,999 / month; Yearly Plan: PKR 9,999 / year (50% OFF from PKR 19,999)
- **Platform Support:** Web browser (Windows, macOS, Android, iOS) and installable Progressive Web App (PWA)
- **Security & Privacy:** Multi-tenant PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) per agency workspace, server-side encrypted Gmail App Passwords, full JSON/Excel/PDF data export
- **Official Contact:** Email `tamspro12@gmail.com` | Phone & WhatsApp `+92 319 0846768`

## Core Application Modules

1. **Dashboard (`/app/dashboard`):** Live KPI overview of total invoiced sales, net profit, client receivables, vendor payables, cash/bank balances, and recent activity.
2. **Sales & Expenses Hub (`/app/sales-expenses`):**
   - **Booking Invoices:** Multi-service invoicing for Airline Tickets (PNR, ticket number, sector, airline, fare, taxes), Umrah packages, Visas, Hotels, Transport, and Insurance with automatic double-entry posting to client receivables and supplier payables.
   - **Payment Vouchers:** Cash/Bank Receipt Vouchers (CRV) and Payment Vouchers (CPV) linked to invoices, parties, and agency bank accounts.
   - **Refunds & Voids:** Structured customer refund and ticket void processing that automatically adjusts client and vendor ledgers.
   - **Daily Operating Expenses:** Office expense tracking linked to Cash or Bank accounts.
3. **Clients & Vendors (`/app/clients-vendors`):** Unified master party directory (`Client`, `Vendor`, or `Both`) and registered Agency Bank accounts with running PKR debit/credit balances and one-click Party Ledger statements.
4. **Queries & Quotations Hub (`/app/leads-quotes`):** Log incoming travel inquiries, build multi-option branded PDF quotations, and convert approved quotes directly into booking invoices.
5. **Umrah Cost Calculator (`/app/umrah-calculator`):** Calculate Makkah and Madinah hotel packages across Sharing, Quint, Quad, Triple, and Double room types with live SAR-to-PKR exchange rates, visa fees, transport, ziyarat, flights, and per-person profit margins.
6. **Financial & Operations Reports (`/app/reports`):** Daily Report (Day Book), Party Account Statements with overdue aging buckets (`0-30`, `31-60`, `61-90`, `90+` days), Booking-Wise Profit Report, and Profit & Loss (P&L) financial statements.
7. **Notifications & Reminders (`/app/notifications`):** Automated alerts for upcoming flight/Umrah departures, overdue client payments, vendor payables, and custom staff reminders.
8. **Settings & Branding (`/app/settings`):** Custom agency logo and PDF invoice/voucher templates, sub-user staff role permissions, agency-owned Gmail integration, and full workspace data export.
